info.title: Fenergo Nebula Portal Tenant Query
info.description:
**Portal Tenant Query API**:
Portal Tenant Query API provides methods related to the Portal Users. Use the Portal Tenant Query API to retrieve list of Users, user details and get password reset ticket. Use the Portal Tenant Query API to retrieve list of Entities linked to portal user.
**Portal Tenant Query API provides**:
  • The ability to query for Portal Users.
  • The ability to query for Portal User details.
  • The ability to query for Entities linked to the user.
  • The ability to get password reset ticket.
